notes.title: Just a heads up
notes.notes:
False Skies is coming out on the 30th; because of this, I'm going to be closing up the playtest a day earlier, on Tuesday evening.

If there's any save files you want to back up or comments you'd like to get to me, best do that in the next few days!

notes.title: New Game Options menu
notes.notes:
I added in a few options for new games today. Normally, they're only accessible after you 1) reach an ending, and 2) find a certain shop and buy those options with a currency accessible at the end of the game.

This is the playtest, though, so skip all that and use this instead:
[url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/eurni0qverog148/32.rsav?dl=0][Here][/url]

Put this into the save folder, which should be in the same directory the game is saved in. Once you do, starting a new game will greet you with a menu with these new options available.

It'd be greatly appreciated if you could poke around with these options and let me know if you run into any issues.




On a related note, I'd like to wrap this playtest up by the 29th, the last Tuesday of the month. If there's anything you'd like to let me know about the game before release, or if you just want to back up your saves, please let me know by then.

notes.title: Beta Access up
notes.notes:
I want to get some people outside my usual groups to test out False Skies, so I'm doing a [fairly limited] beta/playtesting release in order to get some other opinions on the game in.

I've opened up the playtesting option on the main page, and aim to keep it up for a few weeks [until late November, probably], so if you jump in, let me know if you run into any issues.
